blind.description: A stylized wooden speaker's platform or stage featuring a low planked deck with red-painted side panels, a two-step staircase on one side, and an L-shaped wooden gallows-style post holding a suspended bronze or brass bell. The geometry is clean, solid, and continuous with hand-painted stylized wood textures, standing stably directly on the ground.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a rectangular/square wooden deck framed by four corner post tops, with two stairs projecting to the right and a horizontal wooden beam extending inward over the center where the round top of the bell is visible.
blind.height_vs_figure: The top of the bell post reaches about 70-75% the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 4 to 4.5 feet tall), and the platform is roughly 4 feet wide by 4 feet deep including the stairs.

notes: Height proportion differs somewhat from catalog reference but reads accurately as the requested bell platform
